Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the final step (Step 4) by misinterpreting the search results. Although the search for "Frankie Valli Hellogoodbye collaboration" yielded no evidence of a collaboration and showed results related to The Four Seasons, the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Frankie Valli sang with Hellogoodbye." This contradicts both the search findings (which showed no collaboration) and general knowledge (Frankie Valli is the lead singer of The Four Seasons). The Planner failed to correctly synthesize the evidence that there was no collaboration and instead hallucinated a conclusion that directly opposes the available data.
